name: jm-payroll-social
description: Jamaica employer payroll for 2026, PAYE income tax and the statutory contributions an employer deducts and pays (NIS, NHT, Education Tax) plus the employer-only HEART contribution. Gives the monthly threshold of J$149,948 to March 2026 and J$158,530 from April 2026, the J$500,000 monthly break for 30%, the rates and bases, the S01 monthly remittance by the 14th and the S02 annual return by 31 March, and the late-payment charges. Trigger on Jamaica payroll, PAYE Jamaica, S01, S02, statutory deductions, NIS, NHT, Education Tax, HEART levy, TAJ employer. Built from Tax Administration Jamaica publications; not reviewed by an accountant.
